The payments service fails charges with "status=502: risk check unavailable: dial tcp fraud-check.risk.svc.cluster.local:8443: connect: connection refused". Connections to the fraud-check service are refused, so nothing is listening on that port. Successful charges (status=200) are interleaved with these failures in the same time window, which fits a partial outage of the fraud-check dependency. Logs show no failing rollout of payments. I could not look at the fraud-check workload itself: the Loki datasource only holds the payments and storefront services, and no Kubernetes tools were available. So the fraud-check pod state and its recent changes are unverified.</probable_root_cause>
